# Universal Node Graph — Flexible Solutioning

> A domain-neutral graph programming, compilation, search, and experimentation architecture.

## Code

- [Universal core](solutiongraph/): Semantic model, discovery, templates, compiler, structured control, topology search, adaptive allocation, campaign lineage, evidence
- [Reference executor](solutiongraph/executor.py): Strict plan recheck and replaceable runtime adapter boundary
- [Subprocess runtime](solutiongraph/subprocess_runtime.py): Bounded trusted-code lifecycle process adapter
- [Receipt journal](solutiongraph/ledger.py): Fsync-backed, content-chained local evidence persistence
- [Checkpoint protocol](solutiongraph/durable.py): Exact-identity completed-prefix persistence and resume
- [Structured compiler](solutiongraph/structured.py): Composite and bounded-loop lowering to ordinary DAGs
- [Topology search](solutiongraph/topology.py): Explicit graph variants plus compiler-valid route search
- [Graph experiment runner](solutiongraph/graph_experiments.py): Fixed controls plus comparable topology/route execution and reporting
- [Typed graph mutations](solutiongraph/mutations.py): Deterministic topology operators, ancestry, hypotheses, and compiler validation
- [Experiment studies](solutiongraph/studies.py): Paired receipt analysis, uncertainty, and promote/reject/continue recommendations
- [Task solutioning](solutiongraph/solutioning.py): Staged recognition, historical starts, binding, execution, evidence, and immutable learning
- [Data-science design atlas](solutiongraph/design_atlas/): Task archetypes, question packs, technique records, evidence-aware planning, typed context/plan/resolution/report nodes, dossiers, reports, and C0-C7 assessment
- [Evidence ranking](solutiongraph/ranking.py): Shared hard gates, Pareto flags, and transparent weighted projection
- [Streaming reference](solutiongraph/streaming.py): Finite event-time windows, watermarks, late data, and retractions
- [Saga runner](solutiongraph/saga.py): Reverse-order compensation over effectful node contracts
- [Compatibility sidecars](solutiongraph/compatibility.py): Optional port/state/secret/hardware/residency constraints
- [Provenance export](solutiongraph/provenance.py): W3C PROV, OpenLineage, and SLSA projections
- [Advanced conformance](solutiongraph/conformance.py): Installed-wheel execution of eleven advanced mechanisms
- [Workspace scaffold](solutiongraph/scaffold.py): Transactional coding-harness task initialization
- [Campaign contracts](solutiongraph/campaign.py): Hard budgets, population ancestry, evaluator boundaries, and decisions
- [Artifact stores](solutiongraph/artifacts.py): Content-addressed memory and local-file stores
- [Universal solver](solutiongraph/solver.py): Multi-round search, receipt-backed ranking, champion, and diverse route fallbacks
- [DAG Arena](solutiongraph/arena.py): Cross-domain problem catalog and executable suite harness
- [Python node authoring](solutiongraph/authoring.py): Source-bound definitions, signature checks, stable bindings, and exact finite expansion
- [Task/solution packs](solutiongraph/tasking.py): Portable task contracts, cases, oracle identity, and exact closure validation
- [Benchmark runner](solutiongraph/benchmarking.py): Controlled fixed/solver arms and offline JSON/HTML evidence
- [Coding-agent benchmark arena](solutiongraph/agent_bench/): Matched workspaces, no-shell harnesses, ten task bundles, sealed scoring, journals, paired effects, and offline diagrams/reports
- [External benchmark adapters](solutiongraph/benchmark_adapters.py): Claim-safe source-manifest normalization for six external ecosystems
- [Standard-library nodes](solutiongraph/stdlib_pack.py): 19 dependency-free nodes, 32 bindings, discovery sidecars, and a 1,728-route data-quality program
- [Executable domain packs](solutiongraph/examples/): 54 trusted local programs and 449 nodes across data, streaming, GIS, APIs, frontend testing, rendering, web, documents, video, 3D, games, ML, identity, operations, defensive security, science, digital twins, robotics, IoT, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, MLOps, and LLM evaluation
- [Example notebooks](notebooks/): Six numbered execution/A-B notebooks plus a data-science design-atlas workbook
- [Wire schemas](solutiongraph/schemas/): JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts
- [Reference catalogue](catalog/): 42 semantic templates, nine node packs, one linked-graph harness plus typed evidence closure, 63 Arena tasks, and six benchmark/solution packs
- [Browser adapter](browsergraph/): Concrete runtime proof
- [Universal conformance tests](tests/test_solutiongraph.py): Executable architecture requirements
